from ninja import Router, File, UploadedFile
from ninja.security import HttpBearer
from .models import RadiologyImagingOrder
from .schemas import ImagingUploadSchema

radiology_router = Router(auth=HttpBearer())

@radiology_router.post("/imaging-orders/{order_number}/dicom-scan", response=ImagingUploadSchema)
async def upload_dicom_scan(request, order_number: str, scan_file: UploadedFile = File(...)):
    # Asynchronously retrieves medical radiology order by order_number string
    order = await RadiologyImagingOrder.objects.aget(order_number=order_number)

    # Saves uploaded DICOM file without checking hospital clinic affiliation
    file_bytes = await scan_file.read()
    await order.store_scan_series(scan_file.name, file_bytes)

    return {"order_number": order.order_number, "status": "SERIES_UPLOADED"}
diagnosis: upload_dicom_scan allows authenticated hospital portal users to upload medical DICOM scan series by order_number. The endpoint does not verify whether the authenticated technician or physician belongs to the hospital imaging facility where the scan was ordered, enabling unauthorized parties to upload misleading or corrupted imaging scans to patients' clinical radiology records.

corrected_code:
from ninja import Router, File, UploadedFile
from ninja.security import HttpBearer
from ninja.errors import HttpError
from .models import RadiologyImagingOrder
from .schemas import ImagingUploadSchema

radiology_router = Router(auth=HttpBearer())

@radiology_router.post("/imaging-orders/{order_number}/dicom-scan", response=ImagingUploadSchema)
async def upload_dicom_scan(request, order_number: str, scan_file: UploadedFile = File(...)):
    order = await RadiologyImagingOrder.objects.aget(order_number=order_number)

    # Ensure technician belongs to the assigned imaging department facility
    if order.facility_id != request.auth.facility_id:
        raise HttpError(403, "Unauthorized: you do not belong to the hospital facility assigned to this order")

    file_bytes = await scan_file.read()
    await order.store_scan_series(scan_file.name, file_bytes)

    return {"order_number": order.order_number, "status": "SERIES_UPLOADED"}
